source: User-supplied BRIDGEBEAMS VISUAL REVIEW v3 export in conversation
subsequent_user_clarifications: Apparently the dwgs were embeded in the xls file
evidence_policy: Answers below are preserved verbatim. Reviewer interpretations, inferred dimensions and tentative equivalence claims are not automatically publisher dimension callouts. Follow-up records distinguish their provenance.

responses.title: Norway · NTB bottom chamfer and rebates
responses.locator: V426, Figure 3.3.2(a/c/e/g/i); PDF and printed pages 37/39/41/43/45
responses.answer:
Bottom chamfer is 15x15mm; not dimensioned, but very clear form other dimension liens when projected.
Top of beam rebate is 30x30mm
Top of bottom flange rebate is 40mm high; 15mm wide at its top and 20mm (15+5) at its bottom.

responses.title: Norway · KTB asymmetric outline
responses.locator: V426, Figure 3.3.2(b/d/f/h/j); PDF and printed pages 38/40/42/44/46
responses.answer:
p38: KTB570-400x1400 has a 30mm slope over 1400mm depth for its outer face. It's top left edge is 30mm to the left of its bottom left corner. Bottom left chmafer, 15x15mm, bottom right hte same; and top right of bottom flange is the same 15wide at top; 20 wide at bottom, 40mm high chamfer. The top right one is 30x30mm

p40: KTB1200: no slope of left hand face. Same chamfer details as above.

p42: KTB1000: No slope; same chamfer details.

responses.title: New Zealand · 650 single hollow-core outline
responses.answer:
12x12 chamfer at the top of a 320 high recess, starting 220 below top of beam.

Recording the difference between the inner and outer units is too vague - you're asking me to describe both in text and then say whats different. The two drawings are present. in teh second image.

responses.title: New Zealand · 900 single hollow-core outline
responses.answer:
notch starts 430 above bottom of beam; 12x12 chamfer; extends down to 110mm above bottom of beam.

Ditto comment re inner and outer.

responses.title: New Zealand · 587 double hollow-core and edge unit
responses.answer:
12x12 chamfer, notch starts 157mm below top of beam extends to 110mm above bottom of beam.

Ditto comment re inner/outer.

1. Answer is "1" - cm no doubt. The next number over is 2.5cm and then 53cm; so 10 + 25 + 530 + 25 + 10 = 600mm width

2. total widths of bottom flange are: 60 for both. 53cm between chamfers for both.
